Unless stated otherwise, every item can only be purchased once by each model. Any model with access to the Armory can buy as many items as it wants. Items with a cost of "-" can not be selected.
After finishing a Charge move, the enemy unit suffers one automatic wound with S:4 AP:0 D:1 for each 1" distance travelled during the Charge. Unique.
The model gains Deadly(5+) on one of its weapons. If the weapon already has the rule, increase Deadly(x+) by 1. For example Deadly(5+) becomes Deadly(4+). Unique.
A "Pistol" type weapon of the model gains +1 shot per activation. The point cost is the same as the weapon that gets this equipment. Unique.
If the model makes at least one successfull save during its activation, to hit rolls against the model suffer a cumulative -1 penalty until the start of its next activation.
The model gains +6" Movement, +1 Toughness, +1 Wound, a twin shuriken catapult and the ability "Jet bike". Only for infantry.
Enemy units that are fleeing from close combat and get caught receive double the amount of automatic hits from this model and its attached unit.
The model may re-roll one to hit roll per activation. Must be purchased for each weapon seperately.

The model knows one additional psychic power from one of their chosen psychic disciplines. If it already knows all powers from each discipline, it may instead learn one power from a new discipline it has access to. Can be taken multiple times.

One weapon of the model gains one of the following:
- Additional +6" Range (only for ranged weapons)
- Additional +1 Strength
- Additional -1 AP
- Additional +1 AT
Every enhancement is unique per army.
The model may activate its Starmist Raiment to gain a 3+ ward save until the start of its next activation. Ammunition(1), Unique.
A friendly unit arriving within 3" of the bearer via Deep strike does not scatter. The Teleport homer must be present on the table at the beginning of the battle round in order to be used.
The model and all friendly units within 6" gain the "Aegis (5+)" ability.
The model gains a cumulative instance of the "Terrifying(-1)" ability.
The model and its attached unit gain the "Acute Senses" ability.

A friendly unit arriving via Deep Strike within 3" of the bearer does not scatter. Can only be used if the bearer was on the battlefield at the start of the battle round and has not moved more than 12" during that battle round yet.
Roll one die for each glancing and penetrating hit against the model. You may substitute any of the following vehicle damage results with your own roll.
The model does not have to declare its ranged weapons at all targets before firing, and can choose a new target for each weapon.
Equipment such as Icons or Teleport homing beacons do not function within 12" of the model. Additionally, units arriving via Deep Strike that land within 12" roll an additional 2D6 for scattering.
Enemy models reduce their weapons range by 12" (to a minimum of 6"), if they target the bearer.

The model can use its Smoke Launcher once per game:
- During normal activation, instead of firing weapons.
- If it has not yet carried out its order this round and is targeted by an enemy unit. The order is consumed by doing so.
Enemy units can only deal glancing hits with ranged attacks until the next activation.
The model ignores the first "Crew Shaken" vehicle damage each round.
